collection.description: A baby cries through the night.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: A baby cries through the night. Their father, (name1), has tried feeding, changing, and rocking them, and now paces beneath the stars while the rest of the village sleeps.

choices.label: Check with the Healer If Something Seems Wrong

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: The waves calm the baby at last.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: The baby stays awake, but the father enjoys the cool air.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: The baby grows quiet halfway through the second verse.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: He forgets the words and invents increasingly ridiculous ones.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: He gets enough rest to try again with patience.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: The other caregiver is exhausted too, so they split the night.

d1.name: Outcome D1
d1.text: The healer identifies a manageable cause for the distress.

d2.name: Outcome D2
d2.text: No clear cause appears, and they continue monitoring the child.
